## Selected talks

**Subjective and physiological effects of phenomenologically distinct simulated hallucinations in virtual reality.** Motyka, P., Gacka, M., Ayres, C., Karasek, Pochwatko, G., & Suzuki, K. *28th Annual Meeting of the Association for the Scientific Study of Consciousness (ASSC 28)*, Crete, 2025.

**Phenomenologically distinct and intensity-varied VR hallucinations: A platform for simulating and studying altered conscious experience.** Motyka, P., Gacka, M., Ayres, C., Karasek, Pochwatko, G., & Suzuki, K. *Models of Consciousness 6*, Hokkaido, 2025.

**Investigating the role of sensorimotor spatial dependencies in shaping conscious access to virtual 3D objects.** Motyka, P., Schwartzman, D. J., Seth, A. K., & Suzuki, K. *26th Annual Meeting of the Association for the Scientific Study of Consciousness (ASSC 26)*, 2023.
